description: Set a project's freshAccountSetStateId (the state a newly formed account set starts in, such as 'New patient'; null clears it) and parallelAccountSetLimit (the most account sets a batch runs at once). Omitted fields stay unchanged. Returns the whole catalog, as muggle-remote-test-chaining-catalog-get does.

freshAccountSetStateId.description: Test state ID (UUID) a newly formed account set starts in, e.g. 'New patient'; null clears it

parallelAccountSetLimit.description: Most account sets a batch runs at once (default 5)

projectId.description: Project ID (UUID) that owns the test states and roles

name: muggle-remote-test-chaining-settings-update
